amends: commit a4a0b99, which is PRESERVED. This record corrects its language and adds the comparisons it was missing; it does not retract its verdict.

LANGUAGE_CORRECTION.why_it_matters: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. On 30 forward games across two slate dates the challenger's advantage over the expanding prior is indistinguishable from zero. That is a statement about what this sample can resolve, not a finding that the challenger adds nothing.

STRUCTURAL_FINDING_ABOUT_THE_V13_ARM.what_was_asked: Add V13 to the same paired table.
STRUCTURAL_FINDING_ABOUT_THE_V13_ARM.what_the_registry_shows: Both arms on this cohort ALREADY ARE V13. Every one of the 60 forecasts on 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-21 carries model_id ml.v13_1.hfa1005.card.s722n30000. v1 and v2 are not two models — they are two INPUT CONFIGURATIONS of the same frozen model: all-CAP starter inputs versus starter-informed inputs.

so_the_table_is_relabelled.V13_ALL_CAP_INPUTS: the V13 reference for promotion purposes on this cohort

STRUCTURAL_FINDING_ABOUT_THE_V13_ARM.the_other_registered_model: ml.d_logistic_2f.p4.cfg132523ac exists but covers 2026-07-29 through 2026-08-04 only. It has NO overlap with this 30-game cohort and cannot be added to it without changing the game population, which is the error this whole standard exists to prevent.
STRUCTURAL_FINDING_ABOUT_THE_V13_ARM.consequence: On this cohort 'beat both V13 and the expanding prior' reduces to 'beat V13-with-CAP-inputs and beat the prior'. A genuinely distinct V13 arm requires registering one prospectively; it cannot be recovered retroactively.

PREQUENTIAL_PROOF.method: the pool ITSELF is re-derived and audited per row, not the code that built it: every pooled game must be strictly earlier than the target slate date, and the target game must not appear in its own prior
PREQUENTIAL_PROOF.a_gap_this_exposed: prior_last_game_date came back NULL on the first run because home_prior_beta never populated it. An unexposed provenance field is an unchecked one; it is populated now.

PAIRED_DATE_BLOCK_COMPARISONS.clustering: slate date; Holm step-down across the family of two references, alpha 0.05
PAIRED_DATE_BLOCK_COMPARISONS.reading: The challenger clears V13-with-CAP-inputs and does not clear the base rate. Both must fall, so the conjunction fails.

POSTGAME_COMPARATOR_LABELLING.the_correction: The 21 gains / 9 losses and the direction decomposition reported earlier were CHALLENGER vs V13_ALL_CAP_INPUTS. They were not labelled as such. Both comparisons are now produced and every decomposition carries its comparator.
POSTGAME_COMPARATOR_LABELLING.what_the_relabelling_changes: Against the correct reference the gain/loss split INVERTS: 13 gained and 17 lost, not 21 and 9. The headline that looked like a broad win over 30 games is a losing majority once the comparator is the base rate.

HOME_DIRECTION_FINDING_FROZEN.ruling: The 22-8 home slate is an EX-POST CONFOUND, not evidence for increasing home weight. Every directional decomposition here is AUDIT-ONLY and NON-ADAPTIVE.
HOME_DIRECTION_FINDING_FROZEN.enforced_how: no directional quantity appears in the adaptive register at any layer, so adaptive_layers.may_update refuses it at every speed as an unregistered quantity — the default is refusal, not permission
HOME_DIRECTION_FINDING_FROZEN.note: It is recorded so a future sample can test it prospectively. It is not an input.

SAMPLE_REALITY_AGAINST_THE_BINDING_GATE.note: The owner's message refers to nine slate clusters; the paired cohort holds TWO and the repository holds nineteen graded slate dates in total. Either way the binding gate is far out of reach and the 30-game interval is EXPLORATORY.

PREREGISTERED_CONSTANT_FORECAST_GUARD.the_criticism_accepted: The previous guard was a spread threshold set to 1e-6, observed to miss the expanding-prior arm, then widened to 1e-3. That is a threshold adjusted after seeing results.
PREREGISTERED_CONSTANT_FORECAST_GUARD.the_replacement: A CONDITIONING rule with no free parameter. The recalibration solves a 2x2 Newton system; it is reported only when the Hessian's reciprocal condition number exceeds sqrt(float64 epsilon) = 1.4901161193847656e-08, the standard point at which a linear solve retains half its significant digits. Both the floor and the two-distinct-values rule come from the arithmetic, not from any dataset.
PREREGISTERED_CONSTANT_FORECAST_GUARD.verified: catches the real near-constant prior arm at rcond 1.572e-09 and accepts a 3pp-spread forecast at rcond 9.406e-03

OFFSET_ENFORCED.requirement: logit(prior_p_t) as an offset; no unrestricted intercept relearning the base rate
OFFSET_ENFORCED.implemented: baseline_offset.inv6b_residual_has_no_free_intercept refuses any coefficient named like an intercept — and refuses one PINNED TO ZERO as well, because the term must be ABSENT rather than zeroed, so a later fit cannot un-pin it

what_this_does_not_do: It does not retract commit a4a0b99, which stands.
It does not promote anything. Status FORWARD_ONLY_PENDING; gate 0/100 NO_PROMOTE, ledger $0, execution UNAUTHORIZED, wager authority NO.
It does not feed any directional finding back into the model.
